description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017 (Order under Section 22)
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 22 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017. It establishes new financial regulations and limits on foreign currency transactions, including migration allowances, outward remittances, and overseas investments. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only listing his title), and the primary purpose is to enact regulatory changes to foreign exchange controls, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
